plain: I received a defective coffee maker that was dead on arrival.
legal: I received a coffee maker that was defective and failed to operate upon delivery.

plain: Your customer care refused to start a replacement or a refund.
legal: Your customer care department refused to initiate either a replacement or a refund.

plain: If I don't get a replacement or a refund within 15 days, I'll go to my lawyer and sue you.
legal: If I do not receive either a replacement or a refund within fifteen (15) days, I shall instruct my lawyer to commence legal proceedings against you.

plain: If I don't hear back in 15 days I'm going to sue the hell out of you.
legal: Should I not receive a response within fifteen (15) days, I shall commence legal proceedings against you.

plain: I'm writing to complain about the broken washing machine you delivered on June 4.
legal: I write to lodge a formal complaint regarding the defective washing machine that you delivered on June 4.

plain: I paid $899 for it and it stopped working after two days.
legal: I paid the sum of $899 for the item, and it ceased to function after two (2) days.

plain: I want my money back, not store credit.
legal: I demand a full refund of the purchase price and shall not accept store credit in lieu thereof.

plain: We've told you three times that the roof is leaking and you've done nothing.
legal: We have notified you on three (3) occasions that the roof is leaking, and you have failed to take any action.

plain: Fix it by Friday or we'll hire someone and take the cost out of the rent.
legal: You are required to carry out the repair by Friday, failing which we shall engage a third party to do so and deduct the cost thereof from the rent.

plain: I'm cancelling my gym membership effective today.
legal: I hereby terminate my gym membership with immediate effect.

plain: Stop charging my card, I never agreed to a renewal.
legal: You shall cease charging my card immediately, as I have never agreed to any renewal.

plain: You charged me twice for the same order, #48213.
legal: You have charged me twice in respect of the same order, number 48213.

plain: Please refund the extra $54.20 to my account within 5 business days.
legal: I request that you refund the overcharged amount of $54.20 to my account within five (5) business days.

plain: I'm giving you notice that I'll be moving out on August 31.
legal: I hereby give you notice that I shall vacate the premises on August 31.

plain: I expect my full deposit of $1,500 back since the flat is in perfect condition.
legal: As the flat is in perfect condition, I expect the return of my deposit of $1,500 in full.

plain: Your dog has bitten my son twice and you keep letting it off the leash.
legal: Your dog has bitten my son on two (2) occasions, and you continue to allow it off the leash.

plain: If it happens again, I'll report you to the council and the police.
legal: Should any further incident occur, I shall report the matter to the council and the police.

plain: We haven't been paid for the work we finished in March.
legal: We have not received payment for the work that we completed in March.

plain: The invoice was due 45 days ago and you've ignored all our emails.
legal: The invoice became due forty-five (45) days ago, and you have failed to respond to any of our emails.

plain: Pay the $3,200 by the end of next week or we'll send it to a debt collector.
legal: You are required to pay the sum of $3,200 by the end of next week, failing which we shall refer the debt to a collection agency.

plain: I was promised a refund on May 3 and it still hasn't arrived.
legal: I was promised a refund on May 3, and it has not yet been received.

plain: I'm not paying for a service I cancelled in writing.
legal: I shall not pay for a service that I cancelled in writing.

plain: Please confirm in writing that my account is closed.
legal: I request that you confirm in writing that my account has been closed.

plain: You damaged my car while it was in your car park.
legal: You caused damage to my car while it was in your parking facility.

plain: I have photos of the damage and the ticket from that day.
legal: I hold photographs of the damage and the ticket issued on that day.

plain: I expect you to cover the repair quote of £780.
legal: I require you to bear the cost of the repair, as quoted, in the sum of £780.

plain: We're terminating your contract because you missed three deadlines in a row.
legal: We hereby terminate your contract on the ground that you failed to meet three (3) consecutive deadlines.

plain: Don't contact my clients directly again.
legal: You shall not contact my clients directly at any time hereafter.

plain: I did not authorise this transaction and want it reversed.
legal: I did not authorise this transaction, and I hereby request that it be reversed.

plain: Hi, the laptop you sold me overheats and shuts down, and I want it fixed or replaced.
legal: The laptop that you sold to me overheats and shuts down, and I hereby request that it be repaired or replaced.

plain: I'm owed 3 weeks of wages and I need them paid by the 15th.
legal: I am owed three (3) weeks of wages, and I require payment thereof by the fifteenth (15th).

plain: We'll be at the property on Tuesday at 10am to do the inspection.
legal: We shall attend the property on Tuesday at 10am for the purpose of carrying out the inspection.

plain: I've attached the receipt and photos of the faulty part.
legal: I enclose the receipt and photographs of the defective part.

plain: Your contractor left the job half-done and won't answer my calls.
legal: Your contractor left the work incomplete and has not responded to my calls.

plain: I want the remaining $2,000 returned, as the job was never finished.
legal: I demand the return of the remaining $2,000, as the work was never completed.

plain: We regret to tell you that we can't offer you the position.
legal: We regret to inform you that we are unable to offer you the position.

plain: I am withdrawing my offer on the house, effective immediately.
legal: I hereby withdraw my offer on the house with immediate effect.

plain: Sorry for the delay, we'll ship your order by Monday.
legal: We apologise for the delay and shall dispatch your order by Monday.

plain: Your music has kept us awake past midnight every night this week.
legal: The music from your premises has kept us awake beyond midnight on each night of this week.

plain: Please keep it down after 11pm or we'll have to call the landlord.
legal: We request that you keep noise to a minimum after 11pm, failing which we shall have no alternative but to contact the landlord.

plain: I'm disputing the late fee of $35, because I paid on time.
legal: I hereby dispute the late fee of $35, as I made payment on time.

plain: Attached is proof of my payment dated October 2.
legal: I enclose proof of my payment dated October 2.

plain: you guys screwed up my order AGAIN and I'm done, refund me now
legal: You have once again failed to fulfil my order correctly, and I hereby demand an immediate refund.

plain: this is ridiculous, I've waited 6 weeks for a part that was meant to take 5 days
legal: I have waited six (6) weeks for a part that was due to be supplied within five (5) days, which is unacceptable.

plain: if my car isn't ready by thursday you're paying for my rental
legal: If my car is not ready by Thursday, you shall bear the cost of my rental car.

plain: I won't accept anything less than a full refund.
legal: I shall not accept anything less than a full refund.

plain: We are writing to remind you that your rent of $1,150 is now 10 days overdue.
legal: We hereby remind you that your rent of $1,150 is now ten (10) days overdue.

plain: I'm resigning from my role as project manager, and my last day will be January 31.
legal: I hereby resign from my position as project manager, and my final day of employment shall be January 31.

plain: I'd like to formally request a copy of all the personal data you hold about me.
legal: I hereby formally request a copy of all personal data that you hold concerning me.

plain: Please reply to me at maria.lopez@example.com.
legal: Please direct your reply to me at maria.lopez@example.com.

plain: We need the signed contract back from you by June 20 or the offer lapses.
legal: You are required to return the signed contract to us by June 20, failing which the offer shall lapse.

plain: I lent you $600 in February and you promised to pay me back by April.
legal: I lent you the sum of $600 in February, and you undertook to repay it to me by April.

plain: If I'm not repaid by May 31, I'll file a claim in small claims court.
legal: If I am not repaid by May 31, I shall file a small claim with the competent court.

plain: You've parked in my reserved spot four times this month.
legal: You have parked in my reserved parking space on four (4) occasions this month.

plain: Next time I'll have your car towed at your expense.
legal: Should this occur again, I shall have your vehicle towed at your expense.

plain: I'm writing on behalf of my mother, who is a tenant at 12 Elm Street.
legal: I write as the representative of my mother, a tenant residing at 12 Elm Street.

plain: The heating in her flat has been broken since November 2.
legal: The heating in her flat has been inoperative since November 2.

plain: We demand that you remove the fence you built on our land within 30 days.
legal: We hereby demand that you remove the fence that you erected on our land within thirty (30) days.

plain: Thank you for your letter of 8 March; we accept your offer of $12,000.
legal: We acknowledge receipt of your letter dated 8 March and hereby accept your offer of $12,000.

plain: I'm sorry but I can't make the payment this month; I'll pay double next month.
legal: I regret that I am unable to make the payment due this month; I shall pay twice the amount due next month.

plain: We noticed you have been using our photos without permission.
legal: It has come to our attention that you have been using our photographs without our permission.

plain: Take them down within 48 hours or we'll take legal action.
legal: You are required to remove them within forty-eight (48) hours, failing which we shall take legal action against you.

plain: I never received the package, even though the tracking says delivered.
legal: I have never received the package, notwithstanding that the tracking information indicates that it was delivered.

plain: Please either resend it or refund me $72.50.
legal: I request that you either dispatch a replacement or refund to me the sum of $72.50.

plain: I've been charged for a subscription I cancelled on 3 January.
legal: You have charged me for a subscription which I cancelled on 3 January.

plain: I'm not happy with the work and won't be paying the final invoice until it's fixed.
legal: I am not satisfied with the work and shall not pay the final invoice until the defects have been remedied.

plain: Our son was injured on your playground equipment on 5 May.
legal: Our son sustained an injury on your playground equipment on 5 May.

plain: We want to know what you're going to do about it.
legal: We request that you inform us of the steps that you intend to take in respect of this matter.

plain: My flight was cancelled and nobody offered me a hotel or food.
legal: My flight was cancelled, and no hotel accommodation or meals were offered to me.

plain: I'm claiming the €600 compensation I'm entitled to.
legal: I hereby claim the compensation of €600 to which I am entitled.

plain: Dear Mr Patel, I am writing to tell you that your lease ends on 30 June.
legal: Dear Mr Patel, I write to inform you that your lease shall expire on 30 June.

plain: As discussed on the phone, we'll pay the remaining $4,500 in two parts.
legal: Further to our telephone conversation, we shall pay the remaining $4,500 in two (2) instalments.

plain: The first part will be paid on 1 September and the second on 1 October.
legal: The first instalment shall be paid on 1 September and the second instalment on 1 October.

plain: I don't consent to you sharing my details with any third party.
legal: I do not consent to the disclosure of my details by you to any third party.

plain: if u dont fix the leak by tomorrow im calling a plumber and sending u the bill
legal: If you do not repair the leak by tomorrow, I shall engage a plumber and forward the invoice to you.

plain: we're really disappointed, the venue was half the size you advertised
legal: We are deeply dissatisfied, as the venue was half the size that you advertised.

plain: We want 50% of the booking fee back.
legal: We hereby demand a refund of 50% of the booking fee.

plain: I've been your customer for 8 years and this is how you treat me?
legal: I have been your customer for eight (8) years, and I object to the manner in which I have been treated.

plain: Consider this my final warning before I take legal action.
legal: Please treat this letter as my final warning prior to the commencement of legal action.

plain: I hope we can sort this out without going to court.
legal: I trust that this matter may be resolved without recourse to litigation.

plain: I've decided not to renew my contract when it ends on 31 March.
legal: I hereby give notice that I shall not renew my contract upon its expiry on 31 March.

plain: We can confirm that your booking for 12 guests on 5 December is now cancelled.
legal: We hereby confirm the cancellation of your booking for twelve (12) guests on 5 December.

plain: Your payment of $275 bounced, so please pay again within 3 days.
legal: Your payment of $275 was returned unpaid; accordingly, you are required to make payment again within three (3) days.

plain: I'm writing to say I've moved and my new address is 9 Quay Lane.
legal: I write to inform you that I have relocated and that my new address is 9 Quay Lane.

plain: Please stop sending marketing emails to tom.reed@example.org.
legal: I hereby request that you cease sending marketing emails to tom.reed@example.org.

plain: We've found water damage in the flat that wasn't there when you moved in.
legal: We have identified water damage in the flat that was not present at the commencement of your tenancy.

plain: We'll be keeping $300 of your deposit to cover the repair.
legal: We shall retain $300 of your deposit to cover the cost of the repair.

plain: I disagree with the deduction and want the full amount back.
legal: I dispute the deduction and hereby demand the return of the full amount.

plain: Your shop sold me a phone with a cracked screen and refused to swap it.
legal: Your shop supplied me with a phone bearing a cracked screen and subsequently refused to exchange it.

plain: I'm giving you 10 days to make this right.
legal: I hereby allow you ten (10) days within which to remedy this matter.

plain: we've been waiting since 9am and the movers still haven't shown up
legal: We have been waiting since 9am, and the removal company has still not arrived.

plain: if they're not here by noon we're cancelling and want the deposit back
legal: If the removal company has not arrived by noon, we shall cancel the booking and require the return of our deposit.

plain: Thanks for the quote; we accept it and would like the work to start on 2 May.
legal: We acknowledge receipt of your quotation, which we hereby accept, and request that the work commence on 2 May.

plain: I'm sorry to say we have to let you go at the end of this month.
legal: We regret to inform you that your employment shall be terminated at the end of this month.

plain: You'll get 2 months' pay as a severance payment.
legal: You shall receive two (2) months' pay by way of severance payment.

plain: I'm reporting that my laptop was stolen from the office on 18 November.
legal: I hereby report that my laptop was stolen from the office on 18 November.

plain: we told you the deadline was the 30th and you still missed it
legal: We informed you that the deadline was the thirtieth (30th), and you nonetheless failed to meet it.

plain: I'll pay the remaining balance once the defects are fixed.
legal: I shall pay the remaining balance upon rectification of the defects.

plain: Please don't share my medical records with my employer.
legal: I hereby request that you do not disclose my medical records to my employer.

plain: If you keep ignoring me, you'll be hearing from my solicitor.
legal: Should you continue to disregard my correspondence, my solicitor shall contact you.
